## New commands
- `chat-gpt-chat`: ChatGPT answers for a prompt
- `facebook-profile`: Facebook profile, posts and photos
- `google-finance`: Google Finance quotes, charts and news
- `google-flights-deals`: flight deals from a plain-language trip description
- `google-scholar` and `google-scholar-cite`: Google Scholar results and citations
- `instagram-comments`: comments on an Instagram post
- `tripadvisor-place`, `tripadvisor-reviews`, `tripadvisor-search`: Tripadvisor places, reviews and search
- `walmart-product`, `walmart-reviews`, `walmart-search`: Walmart products, reviews and search

## Changed
- `google-events` now fetches a single event by `--page-token` (from a `google-serp` result). The old `--q`/`--location` flags are gone; the API no longer accepts them.
- `zillow-listing`: use `--listing-publish-options ownerPosted|agentListed` instead of the removed `--listing-type`.
- `amazon-product`: other sellers are off by default upstream, so `--no-other-sellers` is gone; pass `--other-sellers` to include them.
- New flags: `glassdoor-listing` salary, rating, date, radius and remote filters; `indeed-listing` `--date-posted`, `--remote-type`, `--sponsored-only`, `--next-page`; `google-maps-place --fetch-web-results`; `google-short-videos --tbs`; `web-scraping --auto-mode`.
- Credit costs in `--help` updated to current pricing (e.g. `amazon-product` and `zillow-listing` are 10 credits per call).

## Removed
- `amazon-reviews`: the API was retired because Amazon now requires a login to see reviews.
- `google-maps-posts --next-page-token`: the API no longer paginates posts.

## Fixes
- `--help` shows each flag's real type (`int`, `string`) instead of a word taken from its description.

Upgrade: `hasdata update`
